headline: Surya Roshni releases Q2 and H1 FY27 business update
hook: Surya Roshni reports Q2 and H1 performance
summary: Surya Roshni Limited has submitted a business update for the second quarter and first half of the 2027 fiscal year to the NSE. The filing provides operational and financial highlights for the period ending September 30, 2026. Retail investors can review these details to assess the company's recent growth trajectory and operational efficiency.
why_it_matters: Performance update helps assess stock valuation and growth prospects.
